description: Source file implementing the agent_ucc_listener class for handling UCC commands in a network agent, including device info retrieval, parameter handling, WPS registration, and RFEATURE configuration.

classes.name: agent_ucc_listener
classes.description: Class handling UCC commands for a network agent, including device info, parameter retrieval, WPS, and RFEATURE management.

methods.name: fill_version_reply_string
methods.description: Returns device info in UCC reply format, including vendor, model, and version.

methods.name: handle_dev_get_param
methods.description: Handles retrieval of device parameters such as ALID, MAC address, BSSID, and MLD address.

methods.name: send_cmdu_to_destination
methods.description: Sends a CMDU message to a specified destination MAC address.

methods.name: handle_start_wps_registration
methods.description: Triggers WPS PBC on a specified band/radio.

methods.name: handle_dev_set_rfeature
methods.description: Configures RFEATURE settings, specifically MBO association disallow.

methods.name: handle_dev_exec_action
methods.description: Placeholder for executing device actions; not yet implemented.

methods.name: handle_custom_command
methods.description: Handles custom commands; not supported in agent mode.

methods.name: handle_dev_send_1905_internally
methods.description: Placeholder for internal 1905 message handling; currently returns false.
